remoteVerification.method: Independently fetched note.md and sources.md at the fixed commit through the GitHub connector, then compared their exact UTF-8 bytes with frozen hashes and authored/compiled content.

passed: Existing static test rerun using independently fetched remote article and source ledger; all assertions passed.
Seven narrative sections and complete lead preserve the frozen original; original article and source ledger remain embedded.
Two qualitative diagrams contain four workflow nodes and three procurement scenarios, with reviewed rows and evidence bindings intact.
Five public source links and source previews are present; diagram 1 links S1, S2, S5, and diagram 2 links S1 through S5.
Talent-pool second interviews are not generalized to all interrupted, rejected or out-of-pool applicants. Accessibility adaptations are not presented as independent proof of fairness.
Chipotle 2024 expectations, 2025 self-reported results, and current supplier marketing remain distinct. Twelve to four days is an eight-day difference and approximately 66.7% reduction, not 75%.
Timing start, population, control and causal-effect limits remain explicit. No fabricated price, ROI, ranking or individual hiring decision appears in the diagrams.
PIPL Article 24 and Article 55 scopes remain distinct; no named-company illegality claim is introduced.
Build manifest matches actual HTML/snapshot bytes and hashes. Compiled article/story payloads match reviewed author content.
All 241 checked non-content official files match their prepared fingerprints.

Static HTML and decoded authored JSON checks found no listed private local paths, private conversation links, Library IDs, internal project IDs, apparent credential payloads or candidate records. Broad sk- matches were inspected and were CSS identifiers containing dashboard-ask, not credentials.
Relative sources.md references are rewritten to the fixed-commit GitHub source-ledger URL in narrative and original views. This is source-code validation, not a browser-click test.

issues.description: The production-root build-qa.json refers to visual-qa-status.json without its source/ prefix. The actual record exists in source/visual-qa-status.json. Clarifying the relative path would make the audit trail easier to follow.

scopeLimits: This review checks frozen-source fidelity, evidence wording, authored diagrams and build/static integrity. It is not an independent validation of the brands' business outcomes.
The original five web pages were not reopened during this audit; source statements were checked against the independently retrieved first-commit body and source ledger.
No preview bypass, rehosting, publication, portal integration, file upload or Git write was performed by this audit.
Pattern scanning is not a formal security guarantee; no private payload was found in the examined authored data.

changes: visualAndInteraction.record points to the sibling archived visual-qa-status.json.
The original documentation-only path issue is retained as a historical finding; sibling archive links are valid.
